specific_findings: Actual768PNG has two red wide-end pairs A top/D bottom and two blue narrow-end pairs A bottom/D top. All five silhouettes, grey openings, A-E labels and full view preserved. No E waist ink, no waterline, no tick scale.8 actions form4 bilateral regions; both sides encode widths. Human uses water from base; decorative rim colors do not create a different capacity or answer.
math_proof: A is uniquely above half height; B,C,E exactly half height by constant section or up/down profile symmetry; D below half height by decreasing section area. Equal capacity is given, so this comparison uses within-vase volume fractions, not absolute silhouette widths.
